quests.title: The Tides Echo Themselves

dialogue.t: Hmm, these ice pillars are working great. What should I practice next...
{NICKNAME}, you're just in time! Come on, give these ice pillars a try!

dialogue.sit: Do I have to sing too?

dialogue.t: Nope! Here, take this. It can make the ice pillars ring.
Go on! I'd quite like to hear what song you'll play.
Go on! I'd quite like to hear what song you'll play.
What do you think? This private practice room of mine is pretty great, right? The song you played just now was quite original, too.

dialogue.sit: I thought my performance was missing a little something.
I couldn't shatter the ice pillars...

dialogue.t: Pfft... If that's your goal, then you've got a long road ahead of you.
I suppose I could offer some guidance... for a price.
Not sure yet. I'll let you know once I think of something fun. Until then, you owe me.
Hehe, pleasure doing business with you! Be sure to come over and practice whenever you're free.

quests.description: There seems to be something new and strange within the Tidesong Cavern…
